title: Easy garlic butter chicken thighs
description:
Garlic butter chicken thighs, 35 min!

Ingredients:
- 6 bone-in chicken thighs
- 4 tbsp butter
- 5 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tsp paprika
- salt and pepper
- 1 tbsp chopped parsley

Method:
1. Season thighs with salt, pepper and paprika.
2. Sear skin-side down 6 min, flip 4 min.
3. Add butter and garlic, baste, then bake at 400F for 20 min.
4. Top with parsley.

Serves 4. #chicken #dinner
